name: epistemic-fork
description: Operationalizes Herdagdelen, Joren, & Tamkin (2026, 'Who\'s Aligned to Whom? How AI Agents Shape Experts\' Research Judgment Calls') into a 4-mode Specification & Judgment Matrix engine (matrix, sweep, lock, audit). Separates verifiable procedural hygiene from underdetermined judgment axes, maps N-way and continuous choices across Level-2 structural worldviews, failure modes, discriminating diagnostics, and marginal leverage, and provides zero-advocacy execution lock plus two-pass antipodal stress-testing.
